content_data.project_title: Automated Content Rights Compliance Verification System
content_data.project_description: Build a real-time compliance engine to validate streaming content rights across North American territories, ensuring regulatory adherence and reducing manual audit overhead.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1 (months 1-4) for architecture and infrastructure, Phase 2 (months 5-10) for core development, and Phase 3 (months 11-14) for integration and testing
objectives: Implement real-time rights validation integrated with content delivery pipeline
Automate compliance verification for content licensing across all North American regions
Create comprehensive audit trail system for regulatory reporting
deliverables: Automated reporting system for regulatory submissions
Microservices-based compliance verification engine with API gateway
CI/CD pipeline with automated testing framework
success_metrics: API response time under 200ms for 99th percentile requests
95% reduction in manual compliance verification tasks within first 6 months post-launch
